message: On my way back to my room, I received a call.

name: Asahi
message: 「A call at this hour? Who on earth could it be...?」
Checking the screen, I couldn't help but frown a little. It was from my older brother, Takahisa.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Yes, hello.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Wazzup, Asahiii！ How's it going~？！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...I was feeling exceedingly well until just a moment ago, but hearing your voice has left me completely exhausted, Brother.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Therefore I think I will turn in for the day goodnight.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Whoa, wait, wait, wait！ That's just cold~！」
Ugh... Honestly, this guy. Just listening to his <d0070>flippant</d> voice gets on my nerves.

name: Asahi
message: 「Do you need something?」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Nah, nothing in particular, I was just wondering how Asahi-chan's doing now that she's started at the academy.」

name: Asahi
message: 「If you don't need anything, I'm hanging up.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Wait, please wait！ Come on, enjoy a little chat time with your big brother~！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm quite fine without it.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Now, now, what's the harm? Just for a little bit~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Haah... You really are something else...」
No matter how coldly you treat him or how much you smack him around, he never gets discouraged. There's no point saying anything to a flimsy scrap of paper.

name: Takahisa
message: 「So how is it, Asahi? Having fun at the academy?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I came to the academy to study Jindou. I'm not here to play around.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Ahh, thought so. That's why I called, you know. You're such a straight-laced girl, Asahi-chan, so it's just like I worried.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You've got this precious academy life—you gotta enjoy it more~！」
I got irritated and considered gently, calmly tearing him to shreds verbally—complete with a thorough character assassination—but decided against it.
After all, Iori-sensei had said something similar.

name: Asahi
message: 「...Mind your own business.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'm blessed with good teachers and receiving high-quality instruction. There isn't a single thing for you to worry about.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I see~ Well, an academy like that must have tons of strong people, right？ Don't tell me you found a guy you're interested in？ Haha！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I've already set my heart on someone.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Whoops, my bad! Sorry, sorry, just kidding!」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Well, you know, the academy draws the strongest people from all over the country, so I'm sure you get down on yourself sometimes.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「But you're plenty strong, Asahi, so don't sweat it too much.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yes... I know.」
My brother is flaky and really annoying. But he does truly care about me.
That kindness... it made me happy, for once.

name: Takahisa
message: 「...So, what's the real deal？ Tell me the truth, my little sister.」

name: Asahi
message: 「What is it you want to hear？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh, come on！ Back when I was there, there's no way the guys would've left a cute girl like you alone！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Even if you've got your heart set on someone, if a guy right in front of you started hitting on you hard, your heart might waver...」

name: Asahi
message: 「That is impossible. I cannot forgive the mere assumption that my feelings would waver for something so trivial.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Once I get back home, I’m going to beat you to a pulp, so prepare yourself.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Whoa, whoa, give me a break!」

name: Takahisa
message: 「But still, you really are unwavering, aren't you, Asahi... I don't know if Iori is lucky or cursed.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I will do my utmost to ensure he feels lucky.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I see, well, if that's how you feel, I'll root for you.」

name: Asahi
message: 「I have no need for your support.」
I snapped at him.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh, by the way, the Martial Festival is coming up soon, right？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「You know how it is—people get anxious around this time, so I was a bit worried about you.」

name: Asahi
message: （Seriously... how do you always know?）
He can be thoughtful and he’s a kind brother. I know that, but still...

name: Takahisa
message: 「High-quality instruction, huh? What kind of teacher is it? There aren't many teachers who’d meet your standards, are there?」

name: Asahi
message: 「...He is a very serious, thoughtful, and kind teacher who genuinely cares about helping me with my concerns.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I see, I see! That sounds just like him. No wonder he's caught your interest!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Y-yes... I suppose so.」
I can't tell him. That my teacher is Iori... Or maybe, I'm the one who doesn't want to tell him.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Well, training is probably gonna be pretty brutal and tough, but just make sure you don't get hurt, alright?」

name: Asahi
message: 「I'll be fine. I won't be clumsy like you, brother.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「...Hahaha, yeah, true. Guess I'm not really in a position to talk after the massive injury I got, am I?」
I regret saying it the moment it leaves my lips. Brother is laughing, but I must have hurt him.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Anyway, just give it your all and come back in one piece, that's all that matters.」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Alright then, good luck！ I can't go cheer for you in person, but I know you'll be able to become the Toujinegi, Asahi！」

name: Takahisa
message: 「See ya later！」
After saying his piece, my brother hung up.
Regret comes crashing over me like a tidal wave.
My brother is bright, cheerful, and chatty. He’s the polar opposite of me.
One might even say our personalities are complete opposites.
Maybe because of that, I can never bring myself to get along with him, and I end up blurting out things I shouldn't.

name: Asahi
message: 「I do want to change how I act, but...」
Whenever I start talking to my brother, I can't help but get irritated. Things rarely go the way I want them to.
――My family runs a kendo dojo, and by the time I was old enough to understand things, my brother was already swinging a sword.
My brother was incredibly strong; he entered a regional tournament with adults while still in elementary school. He won brilliantly, and it was quite the talk of the town back then.
Watching his back, I naturally started Jindou as well. I wanted to get even a little bit closer to my cool brother.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Asahi! I did it, big brother won!」

name: Asahi
message: 「No fair, big brother, I want to do it too！ I want to be number one in Jindou too！」
My brother was so happy that I had started Jindou by chasing after him like that.

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh! That's great! You've got real talent, Asahi!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, really？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Yeah, you're way better than me！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yay! Then I'll work even harder!」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Oh! Amazing, amazing, that's amazing! That's my Asahi. You can already do that much?!」
My brother always used to praise me.

name: Takahisa
message: 「You're so strong, Asahi! You're gonna become the best swordsman in Japan someday!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yeah, I... I wanna become the best swordsman in Japan! Are you gonna be the best in Japan too, Big Brother？」

name: Takahisa
message: 「I want to become a pro Jindou athlete in the future. And then I'll make this dojo even bigger and livelier！」

name: Asahi
message: 「I wanna be a pro athlete too!」

name: Takahisa
message: 「Sounds great! Then let's both become pro Jindou athletes!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Yeah, Big Brother!」
My brother spared no time, patiently teaching me Jindou step by step.
Strong and kind... He was a brother I was truly proud of.

name: Asahi
message: 「Brother...」
I know how my brother truly feels.
That's why I'll become the Toujinegi. And once I graduate from here, I'll become a pro Jindou athlete.
When that dream comes true, then―I'm sure I'll finally be able to face my brother head―on.
And for that.

name: Asahi
message: 「I have to... get stronger...」
...For my own sake, and for my brother's too. Clenching my fists, I headed back to my room.
